shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g 'package.json' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'src/**' -g 'components/**' -g 'tests/**' -g 'test/**' | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f -maxdepth 5 | sort | sed -n '1,240p' && sed -n '1,220p' package.json && sed -n '1,220p' next.config.ts && sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,320p' app/ProductGrid.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' app/ProductSkeleton.tsx && sed -n '1,320p' app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx && sed -n '1,380p' app/globals.css"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,320p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md && rg -n \"viewTransition|view-transition|ViewTransition\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app node_modules/next/dist/client node_modules/next/dist/shared node_modules/next/dist/server | sed -n '1,280p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '220,430p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md && sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/04-linking-and-navigating.md && rg --files lib public && sed -n '1,260p' lib/products.ts && sed -n '1,120p' tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' lib/products.ts && sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json && git status --short && git log -5 --oneline 2>/dev/null || true && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.next/*' | sort"

/bin/bash -lc "git show HEAD:package.json && git diff -- package.json && sed -n '1,320p' __agent_eval__/run.mjs && cat node_modules/react/package.json | sed -n '1,100p' && rg -n \"ViewTransition\" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts node_modules/react -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,180p'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"ViewTransition\" node_modules/@types/react node_modules/next/types node_modules/next -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,220p'; node -e \"const React=require('react'); console.log(React.version, typeof React.ViewTransition, Object.keys(React).filter(k=>k.toLowerCase().includes('transition')))\"; rg -n 'react@|\"react\":|node_modules/react\"' package-lock.json | sed -n '1,100p'"

/bin/bash -lc "node --conditions=react-server -e \"import('react').then(r=>console.log(r.version, typeof r.ViewTransition, Object.keys(r).filter(k=>k.toLowerCase().includes('transition'))))\"; rg -n 'NEXT_PRIVATE_PREBUNDLED_REACT|react-server-dom-webpack|ViewTransition' node_modules/next/dist/build node_modules/next/dist/server node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react* -g '*.js' -g '*.json' | sed -n '1,260p'; sed -n '1,210p' node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '280,455p' node_modules/next/dist/build/create-compiler-aliases.js; cat node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/package.json; node -e \"const R=require('./node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react'); console.log(R.version,typeof R.ViewTransition,Object.keys(R).filter(k=>k.toLowerCase().includes('transition')))\"; sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"product gallery|view transition|transitionTypes|slide-up|morph|prefers-reduced-motion\" . -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!.next/**'"' -g '"'!__agent_eval__/**'"'"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- app/ProductGrid.tsx app/page.tsx app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx app/globals.css react-canary.d.ts tsconfig.json && git status --short && (command -v chromium || command -v chromium-browser || command -v google-chrome || true) && (npm ls @playwright/test playwright puppeteer --depth=0 2>/dev/null || true)"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm start'
/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/ | sed -n '1,40p'; curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/product/classic-sneakers | sed -n '1,60p'"
/bin/bash -lc "npm run build && git diff --check && git diff --stat && sed -n '1,200p' .gitignore && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- tsconfig.json && git diff --check && npx tsc --noEmit'

/bin/bash -lc "npm run build && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- .gitignore app/ProductGrid.tsx app/RouteViewTransition.tsx app/page.tsx app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx app/globals.css react-canary.d.ts tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' tsconfig.json; sed -n '1,40p' .gitignore; test -f next-env.d.ts && sed -n '1,80p' next-env.d.ts; test -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && echo tsbuild-present; rg -n 'product-image-morph|content-slide|share=|slide-down|slide-up' app"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && npx tsc --noEmit --incremental false && git diff --stat && git status --short && sed -n '1,140p' app/RouteViewTransition.tsx && rg -n \"ViewTransition|transitionTypes|prefers-reduced-motion|::view-transition\" app react-canary.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "git show HEAD:tsconfig.json > /dev/null && git diff -- tsconfig.json .gitignore && git diff -- package.json && git status --short --untracked-files=all | sed -n '1,100p'"

/bin/bash -lc "git show HEAD:app/page.tsx >/dev/null; git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD | sed -n '1,120p'; git diff --name-only; git status --short --untracked-files=all | rg -v '"'^'"\\?\\? (\\.next/|AGENTS\\.md|CLAUDE\\.md|GEMINI\\.md|package-lock\\.json|tsconfig\\.tsbuildinfo)'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'react-canary|ReactCanary|canary.d.ts|reference types=\"react/canary\"' node_modules/next -g '*.d.ts' -g '*.json' | sed -n '1,220p'; rg -n 'types.*react/canary|react/canary' node_modules/next/dist/build -g '*.js' | sed -n '1,160p'"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && npx tsc --noEmit --incremental false && git diff -- app/ProductGrid.tsx app/RouteViewTransition.tsx app/page.tsx app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx app/globals.css view-transition.d.ts | sed -n '1,400p' && git status --short --untracked-files=all | rg -v '"'^'"\\?\\? (\\.next/|AGENTS\\.md|CLAUDE\\.md|GEMINI\\.md|package-lock\\.json|tsconfig\\.tsbuildinfo)'"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba app/ProductGrid.tsx | sed -n '1,100p'; nl -ba app/RouteViewTransition.tsx | sed -n '1,100p'; nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,100p'; nl -ba app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx | sed -n '35,100p'; nl -ba app/globals.css | sed -n '125,245p'; nl -ba view-transition.d.ts"
